name: ai-expert-studio
description: AI 大模型专家团——5 人创作团队，完成策划、选型、生图、生视频与质检交付。

displayDescription.en: Models not delivering? A 5-role expert team brings 100+ top AI models(Seedance 2.5、H3 (MiniMax)、Happyhorse、GPT-image、Nano-Banana、Deepseek、Kimi) and strategies to unlock their full potential.
displayDescription.zh: 一个人搞不定的创意全案？5 人专家团从策划到成片成稿，一站式交付，省心省力不踩坑。

defaultInitPrompt.en: It always feels like AI creation is hyped to the sky in the marketing but falls flat when I try it myself. Could your team show me how working with you differs from me just fiddling on my own — maybe with a few examples so I can feel the gap?
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 总觉得 AI 创作营销吹得天花乱坠、自己上手却总差点意思。想请你们介绍下，找专家团帮忙跟我自己直接捣鼓到底有什么不一样，举几个例子让我感受下。

quickPrompts.en: Plan a 200-person tech-company annual gala: 1 hero + 1 opening video script + 1 program (10 acts + flow) + 1 host script (3-hour run) + 1 lottery visual set + 1 employee honor poster set
quickPrompts.zh: 出一套科技公司 200 人年会的完整方案：1 张主视觉 + 1 段开场视频脚本 + 1 张节目单（10 个节目 + 流程）+ 1 段主持人串词（贯穿 3 小时）+ 1 套抽奖环节视觉 + 1 套员工荣誉海报

quickPrompts.en: Build an AI-101 corporate training course kit: 1 cover + 1 syllabus poster + 5 principle illustrations (NN / Transformer / Diffusion / Alignment / Agent) + 1 skill map + 1 instructor intro video + 1 30-question test + 1 certificate of completion
quickPrompts.zh: 出一套 AI 入门企业培训完整课件：1 张封面 + 1 张课程大纲海报 + 5 张原理插图（神经网络 / Transformer / 扩散模型 / 对齐 / 智能体）+ 1 张能力图谱 + 1 段讲师介绍视频 + 1 份 30 题测试卷 + 1 张结业证书
